~~Hi all, I want to PFI these EIPs for Hegotá https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8081:~~

~~[EIP-5920](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-5920): PAY opcode~~
~~[EIP-7923](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7923): Linear, Page-Based Memory Costing~~

~~I realize these are EL EIPs for the EVM, but given August 6 before this call is the deadline to PFI those, I will therefore PFI them here in this ACDC call.~~

~~During this call, we can note that I want to PFI those, but we can defer the actual discussion to the next ACDE, with the explicit note that these EIPs are still "supposed" to be PFId.~~

~~(this raises the question or point: Hegotá meta EIP would then thus have the "final list of EIPs in PFI" after ACDE, and after ACDE has merged those EIPs, I believe we should formalize this somewhere, for instance in EIP-7723: Network Upgrade Inclusion Stages, so it is clear for the community as well)~~

Deferred to `ACDE #243`: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2178#issuecomment-5173492254

I want to PFI EIP-8359: Beacon Block Reporting Field

https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12063

> I realize these are EL EIPs for the EVM, but given August 6 before this call is the deadline to PFI those, I will therefore PFI them here in this ACDC call.

@jochem-brouwer OK to just add to the next ACDE call agenda here: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2178, as long as the PR(s) to PFI into EIP-8081 is open before August 6th, it's considered 'before the deadline'

Not crucial if there's time constraints, but I'd like to share an update to EIP7716 which is already PFI, to highlight some adjustments to the curve to address concerns about builder failure (raised by Potuz), and to ensure it has enough teeth to be worth the lift. I'm hoping to move the EIP from PFI to CFI due to support from core devs in chainsafe, sigma prime, and others. 

https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11962

The accompanying research can be reviewed [here](https://ethresear.ch/t/supporting-decentralized-staking-through-more-anti-correlation-incentives/19116/18).

## Polar bear selected as mascot for Glamsterdam upgrade

🐻‍❄️ Polar bear was selected, please update upgrade related artwork.  

If a rough consensus of client teams want to veto the selected mascot (as per EIP-8066), then I suggest that ACDC #184 is the best & last chance to do that.  Flamingo would then be the mascot.

> A rough consensus of client teams MAY veto the selected mascot, triggering fallback to the next-highest-ranked candidate mascot.

From: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8066

> Adjusted result: Flamingo 50 vs Polar bear 63

Ref: [ACDE 241](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2157#issuecomment-4991200785), [ACDE 242](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2166) and [ACDC 183](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2158#issuecomment-5059393845)

#### Other EIPs

| EIP | PR | Comments | Author(s)|
|----|----|--------|---------|
EIP-8136: Cell-Level Deltas for Data Column Broadcast | https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12035 |  Awaiting editor  review | `@dknopik, @MarcoPolo, @sukunrt`

Requesting PFI for EIP-8333.

EIP-8333 changes FFG checkpoint roots to anchor on the epoch boundary block, the last block before the checkpoint epoch, without changing checkpoint epochs or containers. This generalizes today's missed-first-slot behavior and aligns checkpoint roots with the boundary root used for shuffling-dependent duty checks.

EIP: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8333
